status: truthful measurement/schema preparation only; not an approved release

contract.reviewFacts: Exact exerciseId/version/width/height; approved decision, named reviewer/date only after real acceptance; reference/frame/cue hashes match delivered paths.
contract.fixedAnchors: At least2 named genuinely fixed scene anchors, finite in-canvas coordinates and at most1pixel difference on each axis against reference.
contract.invariantDimensions: At least2 named positive finite dimensions, actual measured per-frame values and at most1% relative difference against reference.
contract.phases: No phase exception needed: both feet are planted throughout. Do not declare bell Float airborne. If phases are used instead, every ground phase requires at least2 frames, its own included reference,2anchors/2dimensions and an explicit airborneFrames list.

measurementMethod: Native neutral-white pixels: minimum RGB>130 and maxRGB-minRGB<30. Genuine white heel-edge pixel: leftmost pixel in an inspected heel ROI, then its lowest white y. Sole dimension: inclusive horizontal white span in an inspected lower-sole band. ROIs isolate near and far shoes; a broader initial probe contaminated near width with far shoe and was excluded. Neither arbitrary all-frame constants nor projected3D measurements are used.
diagnosticLimits: These are stable visible raster heel edges and projected outsole spans, not calibrated3D contact centres, force transmission or physical shoe dimensions. Source floor/shoe support and anatomy still require native visual review. Lowest-white-row midpoints drift3–5px under shading and are not used as claimed fixed anchors.

movingBell.observedDiagnosticsFromRoot: Root native inspection reported about104–108×96–98 or101–107×96–102px bell-body bounds depending on isolation method; the bell rotates and handle/head occlusion changes. These are observations, not a passed constant-diameter measurement.
movingBell.truthfulEvidence: Review the same modest bell body/handle topology, two-hand contact (far grip occluded in hike), rotation and slight source-contour variation at native size. Preserve raw pixels; do not force a constant bounding box or infer3D scale/weight from it.

movingHead.nativeFinding: Native full originals show the same bald faceless canonical head at Float/Hike/Mid. It travels and pitches with the hinge; y and axis-aligned bbox change. Scale should be reviewed through comparable cranial/face proportions or an explicitly rotation-aware cranial caliper, with measured uncertainty. No source head rescaling or graft is justified.
movingHead.schemaRecommendation: Do not invent a headScale invariant that passes1%. The two actual planted-shoe spans satisfy the required dimension contract; identity/anatomy checks need candid native review of cranial shape, ear/neck relation and limb proportions.
